Business Process:
Setup an Automotive Cloud org foundation


Personas Involved:
1. Salesforce System Administrator
2. OEM Admin
3. Dealer Admin
Features: Automotive Cloud Foundation, Salesforce GO, Permission Set Licenses, Permission Sets, Profiles, Record Types, Page Layouts, Org Preferences
Valid Variations:
License SKU Names :
1. Automotive Cloud
2. Automotive Cloud - HF OZ
3. Automotive Foundation User
4. Automotive Foundation User - HF OZ
5. Vehicle Connected Services
6. Salesforce Scheduler
7. Field Service (for Service Territory entities)


Setup Method Variations :
Salesforce GO (Guided Setup) - P0
Manual Setup - P1
CI/CD Deployment - P2
Pre-requisites:
Pre-requisites:

1. System Administrator logs in to Org having Automotive Cloud required licenses (SKU Automotive Cloud)
2. Person Accounts already enabled (or sandbox-first toggle planned)
3. Sandbox refreshed from production with no in-flight metadata changes
Scenarios:
Complete the following steps to enable Automotive Foundation entities:

Navigate to Setup
1. Go to Setup in Salesforce.
2. From the Quick Find box, search for and select Salesforce GO

Access Feature Settings
1. Within Salesforce GO, navigate to Features.
2. Locate and select Automotive Cloud Foundation

Complete the guided setup by performing the following:

A. Enable Org Preferences
1. Enable Person Accounts (irreversible — file support ticket; OWD must allow Contact Controlled By Parent or both Private)
2. Enable Automotive Cloud
3. Enable Vehicle Connected Services
4. Enable Salesforce Scheduler
5. Enable Field Service (required for ServiceTerritory, ServiceTerritoryLocation, ServiceTerritoryMember, ServiceTerritoryWorkType, OperatingHours, OperatingHoursHoliday, TimeSlot, Location)
6. Enable Information Authorization Request (for InfoAuthRequestForm, InfoAuthorizationRequest, MultipartyInfoAuthRequest)

B. Assign Permission Set Licenses (PSLs) to user pools
- Automotive Foundation User
- Vehicle Connected Services
- Salesforce Scheduler User
- Field Service Standard / Dispatcher / Resource
- Industry Service Excellence (for InfoAuth* objects)

C. Assign Permission Sets per persona
- OEM Admin: Automotive Cloud Admin, Industry Service Excellence Admin
- Dealer Admin: Automotive Cloud Admin (scoped to dealer)
- Service Advisor: Automotive Cloud Service, Field Service Resource
- Sales Rep / Dealer Sales Executive: Automotive Cloud Sales
- Field Resource: Field Service Resource, Salesforce Scheduler Resource

D. Configure Record Types & Page Layouts
1. Account: Business Account, Person Account
2. Contact: Standard
3. Product2: Vehicle, Parts (mandatory split)
4. Asset: Vehicle, Parts (mandatory split)
5. Asset Account Participant / Asset Contact Participant: Owner, Driver, Co-Driver, Lessee, Insured, Service Contact
6. AssetWarranty: Manufacturer Warranty, Extended Warranty, Service Contract
7. AssetMilestone: Service Due, Inspection Due, Warranty Expiry
8. AssetRelationship: Parent/Child Vehicle, Vehicle/Battery, Vehicle/Trailer
9. AssetDowntimePeriod: Scheduled Maintenance, Unscheduled, Recall
10. Vehicle / VehicleDefinition: Make/Model/Year/Trim picklists wired
11. Appraisal & Appraisal Item: Vehicle Appraisal, Asset Appraisal record types
12. AppraisalAdjustment / AppraisalItemAddOn / AppraisalItemProviderValuation: standard layouts
13. Location: Dealership, Warehouse, Service Center, Customer Address
14. ServiceTerritory: Dealer Territory, Mobile Service Territory, OEM Region
15. OperatingHours: Standard Hours, Extended Hours, Holiday Schedule
16. ProductAttribute / ProductAttributeSetProduct: Vehicle Specs (engine, transmission, drivetrain), Color, Trim
17. ProductMedia / ProductRelatedComponent / ProductRelatedMaterial: Brochures, Accessories, Fluids
18. ProductRelationshipType: Compatible With, Replaces, Supersedes
19. QuoteLineItemRelatedObject: Vehicle, Trade-in, Accessory
20. GeoCountry: standard country picklist (no RT)
21. InfoAuthRequestForm / InfoAuthorizationRequest / MultipartyInfoAuthRequest: Identity Verification, Service Authorization

E. Configure OWD & Sharing
- Account, Contact: per dealer / OEM model
- Asset, Vehicle: Private (sharing inherits from Asset → Vehicle)
- Appraisal*: Private (inherits from Lead/Opportunity/Account/Asset)
- ServiceTerritory*: Public Read Only

F. ARC: NOT touched in foundation. ARC graphs come last (step 43) after all relationship objects exist.

Verification:
1. Run /auto:audit → expect 0 errors against Foundation
2. Run /auto:health-check → confirm all 37 entities reachable

Scenarios:
Load Foundation reference + master data:

A. Geo & Country Reference
1. GeoCountry: confirm standard 250 country list active. Add ISO codes for OEM target markets.

B. Operating Hours & Holidays (Field Service prerequisite)
1. Create OperatingHours: 'Standard Dealer Hours' (Mon-Sat 8am-7pm), 'Extended Service Hours' (Mon-Sun 6am-10pm), '24/7 Roadside'
2. Create OperatingHoursHoliday: regional holidays per OEM market
3. Create TimeSlot rows for each OperatingHours per day-of-week

C. Location & Service Territory graph
1. Create Location records for each dealership, warehouse, service center
2. Create ServiceTerritory: 'OEM West Region', 'Dealer Group North', etc.
3. Create ServiceTerritoryLocation: link Locations to ServiceTerritories
4. Create ServiceTerritoryWorkType: link work types (Service, Inspection, Test Drive, Delivery) to territories
5. Create ServiceTerritoryMember: assign Field Resource users to territories with from/to dates

D. Account & Contact graph
1. Create Business Accounts: OEM, Dealer Groups, Suppliers, Insurance Providers
2. Create Person Accounts (or Account+Contact pairs) for vehicle owners, lessees, drivers
3. Create Contacts under Business Accounts: dealership staff, OEM contacts, service contacts

E. Product graph
1. Create Product2 (Vehicle RT): one row per VehicleDefinition (Make/Model/Year/Trim)
2. Create Product2 (Parts RT): SKUs for parts catalog
3. Create VehicleDefinition: master Make/Model/Year/Trim/Style records
4. Create ProductAttribute: Engine Type, Transmission, Drivetrain, Fuel Type, Color, Trim
5. Create ProductAttributeSetProduct: link attributes to Vehicle Products
6. Create ProductMedia: brochures, hero images, 360 views per Vehicle Product
7. Create ProductRelationshipType: 'Compatible With', 'Replaces', 'Supersedes', 'Accessory For'
8. Create ProductRelatedComponent: Vehicle → standard accessories (rooftop, leather seats, sound system)
9. Create ProductRelatedMaterial: fluids, filters, consumables linked to Vehicle Products

F. Vehicle & Asset graph
1. Create Vehicle records keyed by VIN, linked to VehicleDefinition (master) and to a Make/Model/Year
2. Create Asset (Vehicle RT) records per Vehicle, linked to Account (owner) and Contact (driver)
3. Create Asset (Parts RT) records for inventory parts
4. Create AssetAccountParticipant: link Asset to multiple Accounts (lienholder, lessor, insurer)
5. Create AssetContactParticipant: link Asset to multiple Contacts (driver, co-driver, emergency contact)
6. Create AssetWarranty: one or more warranty records per Vehicle Asset (manufacturer + extended)
7. Create AssetMilestone: scheduled service dates, inspection dates, warranty expiry milestones
8. Create AssetRelationship: parent/child between trailer and tow vehicle, between vehicle and removable battery
9. Create AssetDowntimePeriod: scheduled maintenance windows, recall periods

G. Appraisal graph (Trade-in / Valuation / Sale)
1. Create Appraisal records linked to Lead/Opportunity/Account
2. Create AppraisalItem (Vehicle/Asset variants) per Appraisal
3. Create AppraisalItemAddOn rows for accessories
4. Create AppraisalItemProviderValuation rows for KBB/JD Power/Black Book/Manheim per AppraisalItem
5. Create AppraisalAdjustment rows for Markup, Discount, Reconditioning Cost, Dents

H. Quote linkage
1. Create QuoteLineItemRelatedObject rows linking Vehicles / Trade-in Appraisals / Accessories to Quote Line Items

I. Information Authorization graph
1. Create InfoAuthRequestForm templates for Identity Verification, Service Authorization, Trade-in Consent
2. Create InfoAuthorizationRequest records per service interaction
3. Create MultipartyInfoAuthRequest for joint/lessee scenarios

User Journey: Automotive Foundation - Setup - Integration (External Systems + APIs)
Business Process:
Configure Foundation integrations (Identity Verification, Telematics, Field Service routing, Valuation Providers, MuleSoft, Document Generation)


Personas Involved:
1. Salesforce System Administrator
2. Integration Architect
3. MuleSoft Developer
Features: Named Credentials, External Services, Identity Verification, MuleSoft, Field Service Routing, Document Generation, Audit Trail
Valid Variations:
Integration Variations :
Identity Verification provider (LexisNexis, Onfido, custom) - P0
Telematics provider (single OEM, multi-OEM aggregator) - P0
Valuation provider fan-out (1 / 2 / 4 providers) - P0/P1
Field Service routing engine (OOTB Optimizer, custom) - P1
Document Generation (OOTB DocGen, Conga, Adobe) - P1
MuleSoft Anypoint connector (sandbox, production) - P0
Pre-requisites:
Pre-requisites:

1. Automotive Foundation - Setup - Configuration completed
2. Automotive Foundation - Setup - Data completed
3. Named Credentials and External Services enabled at org level
4. MuleSoft Anypoint org provisioned (if MuleSoft path)
Scenarios:
Configure Foundation integrations:

A. Identity Verification (InfoAuthRequestForm / InfoAuthorizationRequest / MultipartyInfoAuthRequest)
1. Create Named Credential 'IDV_Provider' pointing to identity verification provider
2. Configure External Service for IDV callout
3. Map InfoAuthRequestForm template fields to provider request payload
4. Configure callback handler to update InfoAuthorizationRequest status
5. Failure injection: provider 5xx → InfoAuthorizationRequest stays Pending; auto-retry with exponential backoff

B. Telematics / Vehicle Connected Services
1. Create Named Credential 'Telematics_Provider' (per OEM)
2. Configure event listener for DTC, location, fuel level, tire pressure events
3. Map telematics events to Asset, Vehicle, AssetMilestone (service-due rollups)
4. Configure AEO orchestration: event type → subtype → expression set → Record Alert + Case
5. Failure injection: telematics gateway down → events queue and replay; surface in operations dashboard

C. Field Service / ServiceTerritory routing
1. Configure Salesforce Field Service Optimizer with ServiceTerritory + ServiceTerritoryMember + OperatingHours + TimeSlot inputs
2. Configure routing rules per ServiceTerritoryWorkType
3. Configure mobile metadata cache regeneration trigger on territory data changes

D. Vehicle Valuation Providers (for Appraisal flow)
1. Create Named Credentials per provider: KBB, JD Power, Black Book, Manheim
2. Configure OmniStudio Integration Procedure for multi-provider fan-out
3. Map provider responses to AppraisalItemProviderValuation fields
4. Failure injection: provider timeout (>30s) or 5xx → drop that provider, persist remaining; UI shows retry affordance

E. MuleSoft Anypoint connector (master integration backbone)
1. Configure Anypoint sandbox + production endpoints
2. Configure connector for upstream OEM systems (warranty, recall, parts catalog, financial)
3. Map MuleSoft canonical model to Salesforce Foundation entities (Vehicle, Asset, AssetWarranty, Product2)

F. Document Generation
1. Configure OOTB Document Generation for Trade-in agreements, Sales agreements, Service authorizations
2. Map Appraisal, AssetWarranty, InfoAuthorizationRequest data to document templates

G. Audit Trail & Telemetry hooks
1. Confirm Setup Audit Trail captures Foundation toggle changes and PSL assignments
2. Configure Telemetry counters for Foundation entity record counts (per /auto:health-check)
3. No PII in telemetry; reference fields only
Integration Component: Identity Verification provider, MuleSoft Anypoint, Telematics gateway (per OEM), KBB/JD Power/Black Book/Manheim valuation APIs, Field Service Optimizer, Document Generation engine, OmniStudio Integration Procedures

User Journey: Automotive Foundation - Setup - Reporting (Reports + Dashboards + Agentforce + Telemetry + Audit)

Personas Involved:
1. Salesforce System Administrator
2. Reports & Dashboards Owner
3. Agentforce Owner
4. Compliance Officer
Features: Reports, Dashboards, CRM Analytics, Agentforce for Automotive, Advanced Account Forecasting, Audit Trail, Telemetry
Valid Variations:
Reporting Variations :
Native Reports only - P0
Native Reports + CRM Analytics dashboards - P1
Native + CRM Analytics + Agentforce surfaces - P2
Add Tableau Unified Analytics (TUA) - P3
Pre-requisites:
Pre-requisites:

1. Automotive Foundation - Setup - Configuration completed
2. Automotive Foundation - Setup - Data completed
3. Automotive Foundation - Setup - Integration completed
4. CRM Analytics licensed (for P1+)
5. Agentforce for Automotive licensed (for P2+)
Scenarios:
Configure Foundation reporting:

A. Telemetry counters (must increment as transactional flows run)
1. Number of Vehicles created
2. Number of Assets (Vehicle / Parts) created
3. Number of AssetWarranty records created
4. Number of AssetMilestone records created (service-due / inspection / expiry)
5. Number of AssetDowntimePeriod records (scheduled / unscheduled / recall)
6. Number of AssetRelationship records (parent/child)
7. Number of Asset Account Participants / Asset Contact Participants per Asset
8. Number of Appraisals / AppraisalItems / AppraisalAdjustments / AppraisalItemAddOns / AppraisalItemProviderValuations
9. Number of InfoAuthorizationRequests / MultipartyInfoAuthRequests
10. Number of ServiceTerritory + Member + Location + WorkType records
11. Number of orgs with each Foundation Org Pref turned on

B. Audit Trail
1. Person Account enable event captured
2. Field Service enable event captured
3. PSL assignments captured
4. Identity Verification approval/rejection captured

C. Native Reports (P0 — ship in standard report folder 'Automotive Foundation')
1. Vehicles by Make/Model/Year
2. Assets by Status (Active / In Service / Retired / Disposed)
3. AssetWarranty by Status (Active / Expired / Voided)
4. AssetMilestone upcoming due (next 30 / 60 / 90 days)
5. AssetDowntimePeriod by reason
6. Appraisals by Status / Interest Type / Source
7. ServiceTerritory utilization (Member count / WorkType coverage)
8. Identity Verification request status (Pending / Approved / Rejected)
9. Person Account vs Business Account counts
10. Product2 catalog by RT (Vehicle / Parts) and Brand

D. CRM Analytics dashboards (P1 — Analytics for Automotive)
1. Foundation Health: total vehicles, active warranties, upcoming milestones, downtime by reason
2. Dealer Inventory: Asset (Vehicle RT) by Location and ServiceTerritory
3. Service Operations: ServiceTerritoryMember utilization, OperatingHours coverage gaps
4. Compliance: InfoAuthorizationRequest cycle time and approval rate

E. Agentforce for Automotive surfaces (P2)
1. Topic: 'Vehicle 360' — actions: lookup by VIN, summarize warranty + milestones, list participants
2. Topic: 'Service Territory Coverage' — find available resource for work type at location
3. Topic: 'Appraisal Helper' — summarize appraisal with provider valuations and adjustments
4. Einstein Studio prompt templates: 'Owner Communication Drafter', 'Service Reminder Drafter'

F. Tableau Unified Analytics (TUA) — P3, optional
1. Connect TUA to Foundation entities via Salesforce CDP / Data Cloud

G. Forecasting
1. Advanced Account Forecasting on Account → Vehicle Asset rollups (forecasted service revenue, parts revenue)

H. Compliance reports
1. Audit Trail review report (Foundation setup changes)
2. Identity Verification fair-process report
3. Multi-party authorization completeness report
Integration Component: CRM Analytics, Agentforce for Automotive, Einstein Studio, Tableau Unified Analytics (optional), Advanced Account Forecasting, Audit Trail, Telemetry pipeline
